title: ControlifyEnhanced
description: Bring true PlayStation 5 DualSense immersion to Minecraft with adaptive triggers, advanced haptics, touchpad interactions, speaker effects, and more—built as an addon for Controlify. (and now Do A Barrel Roll and Rolling Down In The Deep)
body:
# Controlify Immersion

Experience Minecraft with the full potential of the PlayStation 5 DualSense controller.

**Controlify Immersion** is a client-side addon for **Controlify** that brings adaptive triggers, immersive haptic feedback, touchpad interactions, controller speaker effects, and other DualSense-exclusive features to Minecraft.

Rather than simply mapping buttons, this addon makes in-game actions feel physical. Mining, combat, exploration, and item interactions become more immersive through realistic controller feedback designed specifically for the DualSense.

## Features

### Adaptive Triggers

* Progressive resistance while mining.
* Resistance changes based on block hardness.
* Trigger resistance while drawing bows and crossbows.
* Trigger resistance while using shields.

### Haptic Feedback

* Mining impacts.
* Combat feedback.
* Explosions.
* Fall damage.
* Walking on different block types.

### Touchpad Support

* Swipe the touchpad up or down to use zoom, left and right for a (meaningless) LED color change on the controller

### Controller Speaker

* Environmental audio effects.
* Additional speaker effects planned for future updates.

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.x
* Fabric Loader
* Controlify

## Client-side Only

This addon only needs to be installed on the client. Servers do **not** need to install it.

## Planned Features

* Expanded haptic effects.
* More adaptive trigger profiles.
* Microphone interactions.
* Additional controller speaker effects.
* More immersive DualSense features.

This project is an unofficial addon for Controlify and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
